sample_unit: sentences (50 deidentified ED discharge instruction sets)

links.outcome: Translation accuracy of ED discharge instructions by target language (Spanish, Chinese, Russian)
links.effect: Sentence-level accuracy: GPT 97%, 95%, 89% and Google Translate 96%, 90%, 80% for Spanish, Chinese, Russian; instruction sets with at least one inaccuracy: GPT 16%, 24%, 56%; Google 24%, 56%, 66%.
links.quote: At the instruction set level, 16%, 24% and 56% of Spanish, Chinese and Russian GPT-translated instruction sets contained at least one inaccuracy.

unlisted_practices: Professional oversight/review of machine translation for non-low-risk patient communication

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and potential clinical harm of ChatGPT-4 and Google Translate for translating patient discharge instructions offline, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice comparison.
